purpose: Isolate economically motivated feature-group contributions before any further model-family comparison.

authority.reason: Every available outcome through 2026-07-22 was viewed in earlier research. No historical interval is a sealed holdout.

decision.display_policy: Always preserve rank 1 and rank 2 on every source-complete scheduled day.
decision.trade_policy_during_feature_screen: No trade gate is selected in the retrospective feature screen. Display-portfolio returns are a common diagnostic control.
decision.future_trade_policy: An out-of-fold expected-net gate may independently leave either 50% sleeve in cash; rank 3 may never replace a gated-off slot. Display and trade picks must be separate artifacts.

anchor_model.date_weight: equal total weight per training date
anchor_model.why_fixed: The model is held constant only to identify feature contribution. Model families may be compared after the feature bundle is locked.

group_screen.use: G0 versus one all-or-none group at a time

union_prune.use: one fixed survivor union and leave-one-group-out

stability_report.use: report the locked retrospective recipe without reselection; still not a holdout

survivor_order: larger top2 net20 uplift over G0
larger paired five-session-block one-sided 80% lower bound
screen.no_survivor_policy: Keep G0. Record the point-estimate leader as a hypothesis only; do not force an addition.
screen.union_policy: Union at most three qualifying groups in survivor order. In union_prune, retain a group only if the union minus that group has lower top2 net20 return. Apply this once; do not iterate.
screen.interaction_policy: Evaluate X0 only when T0 survives the single-addition screen, and only as T0 plus the registered X0 columns.

metrics.primary: scheduled-day top2 equal-weight open-to-close mean after 20 bp
metrics.cash_accounting: Unfilled or unobserved slots are zero return and zero cost; remaining sleeves are not reweighted.
metrics.multiple_testing: Use a shared five-session moving-block resample and the maximum candidate-minus-G0 statistic for the screen lower bound.

data.price_source: JPX monthly historical stock-price PDFs parsed with the repository parser
data.tdnet_source: cached public TDnet date-index mirror pages with observation sidecars
known_limits: The JPX monthly PDFs have AM/PM OHLC and explicit no-trade rows but no usable volume, turnover or lot fields.
The cached TDnet indexes contain titles and PDF URLs, not original disclosure PDF bytes.
Exact historical 08:58 futures, board, indicative-open and PTS snapshots are unavailable.
Retrospective dates are already outcome-known and cannot promote production.

leakage_checks: Mutating target-day and future OHLC/labels cannot change target-day features or ranks.
Every historical price source date is strictly before the target date.
TDnet, futures, board and PTS timestamps must be timezone-aware and no later than target 08:58:59 JST; no carry-forward.
Training, imputation, scaling, calibration and selection use dates strictly before each scoring month.
Cross-sectional ranks use the prior-session point-in-time universe, never target outcome/traded status.
Actual target open, open time, volume, high, low and close are banned from features.
A missing source cannot be converted to no event or zero market move.
Conflicting duplicate snapshots and append-only history rewrites are rejected.
No-trade, missing and unfilled outcomes remain in scheduled-day accounting.

feature_development.interim_access: collector and leakage QA only; no feature changes from interim PnL

sealed_confirmation.starts_after: feature, model and trade gate are content-addressed and locked
